source.title: Open problems and conjectures in complex analysis

trace.notes: Input normalized as zbMATH URL https://zbmath.org/4159017. Direct shell fetch of zbMATH returned HTTP 403 Cloudflare challenge (blocked_or_challenged). zbMATH API document/4159017 succeeded and identified DOI 10.1007/BFb0087893, title "Open problems and conjectures in complex analysis"; API metadata was used only for identity/title recovery, not extraction.

Exact-work recovery found author-hosted PDF https://www.math.ttu.edu/~rbarnard/Papers/Open_Problems_Conjectures_Complex_Analysis.pdf and Springer DOI landing page https://link.springer.com/chapter/10.1007/BFb0087893. CLI download of the author PDF failed with network_or_dns_failure (Could not resolve host: www.math.ttu.edu). Springer landing page exposed metadata/references only and indicated subscription content; it did not provide readable full text. Search and Scribd snippets were rejected as technical sources under the source adequacy gate.

No readable exact-work PDF or full HTML primary source artifact was available for page-level evidence. Extraction from resolver metadata, abstracts, search snippets, or citation-only pages is disallowed, so accepted is empty and the source is routed to needs_review.
Saved final JSON to outputs/parse-paper/4159017.json and outputs/latest.json.
